name: quote-banner
description: 引言横条：全宽 ink 带内反白一句（节奏停顿镜）
css: #tpl-quote-banner { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .qb-band { width: 100%; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); padding: 3.4vh 8vw; font-size: 3.6vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .qb-band", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, {start} + 0.15);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .qb-band", { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.01 }, {start} + 0.15);
